description: Renew vehicle registrations online through the MVC website or in person at an MVC agency. Titles and new registrations are handled at MVC agencies.
eligibility: Vehicle owner registering in New Jersey

name: NJ FamilyCare (New Jersey Medicaid)
agency: New Jersey Department of Human Services
description: NJ FamilyCare is New Jersey's Medicaid and CHIP program, providing free or low-cost health coverage to eligible children and adults. Apply online or by phone.

name: New Jersey SNAP
agency: New Jersey Department of Human Services
description: NJ SNAP provides monthly food benefits to eligible households on a Families First EBT card. Apply online at njsnap.gov or through your county board of social services.
whatToBring: Proof of identity, income, and expenses

name: New Jersey Unemployment Insurance — File a Claim
agency: New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development
description: File for New Jersey unemployment benefits online at myunemployment.nj.gov, then certify for weekly benefits to keep receiving payments. Contact the Department of Labor through its online contact form.
eligibility: Unemployed through no fault of your own
Earned qualifying wages in New Jersey
whatToBring: Bank account info for direct deposit

name: New Jersey Voter Registration
agency: New Jersey Department of State, Division of Elections
description: Register to vote in New Jersey online, by mail, or in person. The registration deadline for the November 3, 2026 general election is October 13, 2026.

deadlines.label: Registration deadline (Nov 3, 2026 general)
deadlines.note: Online, by mail, or in person

whatToBring: NJ driver's license or non-driver ID number (or last 4 of SSN)

name: New Jersey LLC Formation
agency: New Jersey Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (DORES), Department of the Treasury
description: Form a New Jersey LLC by filing a Certificate of Formation online through NJ Business Gateway Services — $100. Annual reports are $75, due by the last day of the LLC's formation month each year.
eligibility: Registered agent with a New Jersey address
whatToBring: Certificate of Formation details (name, registered agent, business purpose)

name: New Jersey Gross Income Tax Filing
agency: New Jersey Division of Taxation
description: File your New Jersey Gross Income Tax return online for free through NJ Online Filing. Questions? Call the automated tax information line at 1-800-323-4400.
eligibility: New Jersey resident, part-year resident, or nonresident with New Jersey income

deadlines.label: Annual return due
deadlines.note: New Jersey returns are due April 15 each year

name: New Jersey Professional Licensing
agency: New Jersey Division of Consumer Affairs
description: The Division of Consumer Affairs licenses and regulates dozens of New Jersey professions, from health care to cosmetology. Apply for and renew licenses online through the MyLicense portal.
eligibility: Meet the education, exam, and experience requirements of your profession

name: New Jersey Birth Certificate
agency: New Jersey Department of Health, Office of Vital Statistics and Registry
description: Order certified copies of New Jersey birth certificates — $25 for the initial copy and $2 for each additional copy. Order online through VitalChek, by mail, or in person at 140 E. Front Street, Trenton.
eligibility: The person named on the record, immediate family, or legal representative
whatToBring: Birth record details (name, date and place of birth, parents' names)

name: WorkFirst New Jersey (WFNJ)
agency: New Jersey Department of Human Services
description: WorkFirst New Jersey is the state's TANF program, providing temporary cash assistance and employment services to low-income families. Apply online through MyNJHelps or in person at your county board of social services.
whatToBring: Proof of identity, income, and residency

name: New Jersey State Parks & Forests Passport
agency: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection, Division of Parks and Forestry
description: New Jersey state parks and forests are free to enter for residents 62 and older, people with total disabilities, and active New Jersey National Guard members; other parks may charge entrance fees, with annual passes available.
eligibility: Free entry for NJ residents 62+, totally disabled persons, and active NJ National Guard
cost: Free for NJ residents 62+, totally disabled, and active National Guard

name: New Mexico Driver's License — New & Renewal
agency: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division (MVD)
description: The New Mexico MVD issues driver's licenses — $18 for four years or $34 for eight years. Renew online at mvdonline.com or in person at an MVD office.
eligibility: U.S. citizen or lawful presence for a license
whatToBring: Proof of identity, Social Security number, and New Mexico residency

name: New Mexico Vehicle Registration & Title
agency: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division (MVD)
description: Register vehicles and renew registrations online, by phone, or in person through the New Mexico MVD.
eligibility: Vehicle owner registering in New Mexico

name: Centennial Care (New Mexico Medicaid)
agency: New Mexico Health Care Authority (HCA)
description: Centennial Care is New Mexico's Medicaid program, providing health coverage to eligible residents through managed care organizations. Apply online through Yes New Mexico.

name: New Mexico SNAP
agency: New Mexico Health Care Authority, Income Support Division
description: New Mexico SNAP provides monthly food benefits to eligible households. Apply online through Yes New Mexico or at a local Income Support Division office.
whatToBring: Proof of identity, income, and expenses

name: New Mexico Unemployment Insurance — File a Claim
agency: New Mexico Department of Workforce Solutions
description: File for New Mexico unemployment benefits online through the Department of Workforce Solutions, then certify weekly to keep receiving payments.
eligibility: Unemployed through no fault of your own
Earned qualifying wages in New Mexico
whatToBring: Bank account info for direct deposit

name: New Mexico Voter Registration
agency: New Mexico Secretary of State
description: New Mexico's regular voter registration deadline for the November 3, 2026 general election was October 6, 2026 — but same-day registration is available during early voting and on Election Day.

deadlines.label: Regular registration
deadlines.note: Passed

deadlines.label: Same-day registration
deadlines.note: Available during early voting and on Election Day

name: New Mexico LLC Formation
agency: New Mexico Secretary of State
description: Form a New Mexico LLC by filing Articles of Organization online with the Secretary of State for $50. New Mexico has no annual report requirement for LLCs.
eligibility: Registered agent with a New Mexico address
whatToBring: Articles of Organization details (name, registered agent, organizers)

name: New Mexico Personal Income Tax Filing
agency: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department
description: File your New Mexico Personal Income Tax return (PIT-1) for free online through the Taxation and Revenue Department's Taxpayer Access Point (TAP).
eligibility: New Mexico resident, part-year resident, or nonresident with New Mexico income

deadlines.label: Annual return due
deadlines.note: New Mexico individual returns are due April 15 each year

name: New Mexico Professional Licensing
agency: New Mexico Regulation and Licensing Department
description: New Mexico's Regulation and Licensing Department oversees licensing for dozens of professions and trades. Apply for and renew licenses online through the RLD licensing portal.
eligibility: Meet the education, exam, and experience requirements of your profession

name: New Mexico Birth Certificate
agency: New Mexico Department of Health, Bureau of Vital Records
description: Order certified copies of New Mexico birth certificates for $10 per copy — online through VitalChek, by mail to P.O. Box 25767, Albuquerque NM 87125, or in person.
eligibility: The person named on the record, immediate family, or legal representative
whatToBring: Birth record details (name, date and place of birth, parents' names)

name: New Mexico TANF (Temporary Assistance for Needy Families)
agency: New Mexico Health Care Authority, Income Support Division
description: New Mexico's TANF program provides temporary cash assistance to low-income families with children, along with employment support. Apply online through Yes New Mexico.
whatToBring: Proof of identity, income, and residency

name: New Mexico State Parks Annual Day-Use Pass
agency: New Mexico State Parks Division, Energy, Minerals and Natural Resources Department
description: The New Mexico State Parks Annual Day-Use Pass covers day-use entry to all state parks for a full year — $75 for residents or $150 for non-residents. Buy online or at a park.
